verdict.rationale: The reemployment tax login page lists an entry path keyed on 'Reemployment Tax Number and FEIN/ITIN' with 'Start a New Return' and 'Make a Payment'. It also offers a document lookup by tax number, FEIN/ITIN and confirmation number. Both sit alongside the separate User ID/Password login, so filing and paying appear startable by file number. However, the probe shows the online Business Tax Application, the registration flow a new founder would start with, serves a login shell with transactions behind an authenticated session. The page fragments also never explicitly say no account is required. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the number-based path needs no account, a keyless path for initial registration, and hands-on confirmation of the no-login filing flow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
